lamp_flicker.prompt: An old desk lamp bulb flickering and buzzing, electric hum with a few short flickers, then settling into a low steady glow, quiet room

keyboard_typing.prompt: Soft laptop keyboard typing at night, a quick burst of gentle keystrokes, quiet room

phone_rise.prompt: A smartphone sliding up from behind a laptop with a soft whoosh, then a gentle clean electronic chime, quiet cozy night room

done_ping.prompt: A cheerful short positive task completed notification ding, clean digital, bright

rocket_car_far.prompt: A tiny distant flying car with a rocket booster passing far away outside a window at night, faint rocket whoosh and soft engine, very far, subtle

shooting_star.prompt: A shooting star streaking across the night sky, a soft airy whoosh with a faint high shimmering tail, very far away and gentle

ufo_pass.prompt: A small distant flying saucer gliding past at night, soft eerie hum with a gentle warbling sci-fi tone, very far away and subtle

amb_quiet.prompt: Very quiet night in a city apartment, faint far-away city hum, a distant dog barking once, calm and still

amb_street.prompt: Quiet street at night heard through a window, occasional distant car passing, soft wind in trees

amb_moon.prompt: Calm night with crickets chirping softly and a light breeze, peaceful and quiet

amb_rain.prompt: Steady rain falling on a window glass at night, cozy and calm, soft distant thunder rumble once

santa_bells.prompt: Distant sleigh bells jingling softly as a sleigh glides across the night sky, very far away, gentle and magical

ketupat_launch.prompt: A soft airy whoosh of a glowing object streaking across the night sky with a gentle high shimmering tail, very far away

fireworks.prompt: Fireworks far away over a city at night, a few soft whistles rising then dull distant booms and crackles, quiet and far

sink_water.prompt: Water running from a tap into a steel sink, a steady gentle stream and light splashing bubbles, close

shutter_roll.prompt: A metal rolling shutter door rising, rattling slats clicking up one after another, a metallic rumble, then stops with a soft clunk
